text.tspan: Life-giving Spirit, find in His word (John 6:63; Jer. 15:16).
Son of Man, have thoroughfare, Lord,
In all my heart so You can grow.
“He who eats Me, he who eats Me,” (John 6:57)
He shall live Me because of Me.
This Christ we’re eating and digesting
Feeding God and serving all men,
Become the Man, a full-grown man. (Eph. 4:13)
Lord, blend us till we’ve become You.
